title: Az európai irodalom alapjai: Homérosztól Goethéig
grammar: Works, Authors and Themes: Homérosz eposza, Goethe Faustja

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name famous works of European literature and their authors, from Homer to Goethe.
I can say briefly what the Odyssey, Hamlet and Faust are about.
I can link a work to its author with the possessive (*Homérosz eposza*, *Goethe Faustja*).
I can use words for epic, tragedy and the Enlightenment.
